title: Last Bell, 2006
logline: Wood at the frame shop, cutting a diploma mat. Small Wood High, class of 2006. The name on it is nobody's.

panels.composition: The frame shop, June. A diploma on the counter: SMALL WOOD HIGH SCHOOL · 2006. WOOD cutting a mat for it. The OWNER on the phone.

image.prompt: a thin man cutting a mat for a high school diploma on a frame-shop counter, the owner on the phone behind him, muddy digital flats

panels.composition: The diploma. A name. The strip smudges it. Class of 2006.

image.prompt: close-up of a high school diploma with the graduate's name smudged into illegibility and the year 2006 clear

panels.composition: Wood holding the mat up to the light. Cream and green. School colors. He knows them.

balloons.text: Cream and green. They haven't changed the colors.

image.prompt: a man holding a cream-and-green double mat up to the window light in a frame shop

panels.composition: The framed diploma on the counter, done. Wood looking at it a beat too long. Then the next ticket. The bell, off-page, rings somewhere.

image.prompt: a framed high school diploma on a shop counter, a thin man looking at it a moment too long before reaching for the next job ticket, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm
